player_prompt.intro:
You are playing PegJump. Jump one peg over another into an empty hole, removing the jumped peg.
Goal: finish with exactly **one** peg left. Action format: e.g. '[4 1]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Takayɩhatʋ ndʋ tɩtɩmʋna yɔ. Tɩŋnɩ [i->j] yɔɔ nɛ ŋlabɩnɩ tʋmɩyɛ.
invalid_move.illegal_move: Paɣtʋ taa lɛ, pɩfɛyɩ ɖeu se ɛyʋ ɛɖɔ nʋmɔʋ ŋgʋ.
